verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub README clearly claim broad ingestion — raw content, documents, files, URLs, JSON via API, plus connectors (Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) and multi-modal extractors (PDFs, images, video, code) — well beyond chat transcripts (supermemory-docs-1, supermemory-gh-1, supermemory-gh-3, supermemory-docs-24). However, independent HN feedback reports a hands-on failure: ingesting a link/tutorial content threw a 'too large' error, directly undercutting the claim that arbitrary documents can be stored (supermemory-comm-1, supermemory-comm-3). missing for 10: independent corroboration that large documents/files ingest reliably in practice, and a vendor response/fix to the reported size-limit failure.
